youtube.title: The Verification Burden | Why AI in Finance Still Needs Human Judgment | Future CFO_DP
youtube.description:
In this Future CFO_DP daily briefing for October 17, 2026, we examine the 2026 Datarails CFO Survey. Every CFO is using AI, yet finance teams spend 26% of their week verifying AI outputs. Only 5% trust AI for board-ready reports.

Key sources:
- Datarails 2026 CFO Sentiments Survey (Oct 6, 2026)
- IBM 2026 CFO Study
- Deloitte findings on AI capital allocation
- Emory Goizueta Center for AI in Finance launch (Oct 12, 2026)

Philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
